name: Factorial Event Scoring
description: Replaced the Laplacian quadratic form with a condition requiring the sum of factorials of the number of selected members per event to equal the total number of events. Since c! >= 1 for all valid c (0, 1, 2), a sum of m terms equals m if and only if all terms are 1, meaning no event has 2 selected members. This perfectly encodes Independent Set while looking like a combinatorial puzzle, defeating models that rely on recognizing matrix algebra patterns.
